**Product / client:**  
**Release / pilot:**  
**Date:**

> Internal risk checkpoint. Mark each item **Pass**, **Needs action**, or **Not applicable** with a short justification and a link to evidence. Do not include credentials, customer records or personal data.

## Core controls

| Item | Result | Evidence / gap owner and deadline |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Audience, jurisdictions and minors assessed | | |
| Data flows, processors, purpose and retention documented | | |
| Privacy notice, lawful basis and user choices assessed | | |
| Access control, secret handling and basic security tested | | |
| Agent permissions, human handoff and high-risk actions bounded | | |
| Relevant errors, data leaks and misuse scenarios tested | | |
| Public product/ROI claims checked against evidence | | |
| External scripts, recording/analytics and vendor terms reviewed | | |
| Contact, complaints, support and rollback routes verified | | |

| Denmark / EU processing, transfers and local rules | | |

## Release decision

**Status:** BLOCKED / CONDITIONAL / READY  
**Open risks and safeguards:**  
**Independent or legal review needed?** Yes / No. Reason:  
**Decision owner and date:**  
**Follow-up review date or trigger:**

**Rule:** A legal or security blocker cannot be waived merely to meet a launch date. For a conditional release, include an accountable owner and deadline. Reference: [OES Launch Compliance Gate](../oes-launch-compliance-gate.md).
